title: OpenAI to Offer Trump Administration a 5% Equity Stake and Other AI Firms Could Also Follow: Report
title_zh: OpenAI 将向特朗普政府提供 5% 的股权，其他人工智能公司也可能效仿：报告
summary: OpenAI is reportedly considering offering the U.S. government a 5% equity stake as part of a broader effort to deepen ties with the Trump administration and secure financial backing. CEO Sam Altman has reportedly held preliminary discussions with the Trump...
summary_zh: 据报道，OpenAI 正在考虑向美国政府提供 5% 的股权，作为加深与特朗普政府关系并确保财务支持的更广泛努力的一部分。据报道，首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼已与特朗普进行了初步讨论......

title: Meta’s Bold $6.5 Billion Power Move to Turbocharge Its Cloud and AI Takeover
title_zh: Meta 斥资 65 亿美元的大胆举措，加速其云和人工智能接管
summary: The AI arms race has entered a new phase. For the past three years, the biggest technology companies have competed by buying as many Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) GPUs as they could get their hands on. Now they’re racing to build something even more valuable: their own AI chips.
summary_zh: 人工智能军备竞赛已进入新阶段。在过去的三年里，最大的科技公司通过购买尽可能多的 Nvidia（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）GPU 来展开竞争。现在，他们正在竞相打造更有价值的东西：自己的人工智能芯片。

title: Foes of PNM takeover applaud as regulators order $400 million stock deal undone
title_zh: 监管机构下令撤销 4 亿美元股票交易，PNM 收购的反对者欢呼雀跃
summary: New Mexico regulators voted Thursday to nullify a year-old purchase of stock in the state’s largest electric utility by a private equity firm and issue penalties against both, finding they violated state law by completing the sale without approval.
summary_zh: 新墨西哥州监管机构周四投票决定取消一家私募股权公司一年前购买该州最大电力公司股票的行为，并对两家公司进行处罚，发现他们未经批准就完成出售，违反了州法律。

title: HSBC Weighs Turkey Exit as Emirates NBD Explores Acquisition Deal
title_zh: 阿联酋国民银行 (Emirates NBD) 探索收购交易，汇丰银行考虑退出土耳其
summary: HSBC is reportedly exploring a sale of its Turkey business to Emirates NBD, extending its global restructuring while sharpening its focus on core growth markets.
summary_zh: 据报道，汇丰银行正在考虑将其土耳其业务出售给阿联酋国民银行，以扩大其全球重组，同时加强对核心增长市场的关注。

title: Does KKR’s (KKR) India Hospital Deal And Fee Shift Reveal A New Earnings Playbook?
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 印度医院交易和费用调整是否揭示了新的盈利策略？
summary: KKR recently entered advanced talks to acquire Sweden-based Medicover’s 66.9% stake in its Indian hospital business for at least US$1.05 billion, while also reporting quarter-to-date monetization income above US$900 million, mostly from realized performance fees.
summary_zh: KKR 最近进入高级谈判，以至少 10.5 亿美元收购总部位于瑞典的 Medicover 在其印度医院业务中 66.9% 的股份，同时报告本季度迄今的货币化收入超过 9 亿美元，其中大部分来自已实现的绩效费用。
